name: Native Neural Engine & SafeTensors Inference
purpose: 100% native Rust neural transformer inference, grouped query attention, SwiGLU activations, RoPE embeddings, RMSNorm, and byte-level BPE tokenization.
registration: ModelRegistry::register_active_training registers trained weights; ModelRegistry::new loads versions manifest.
discovery: ModelRegistry::get_active_version_location discovers model path; TaraBrain::try_load_model attempts load.
execution: generate_stream and generate_response stream tokens via auto-regressive forward passes.
memory_link: KV-cache preserves multi-turn context during active streaming turn.
learning_link: Direct forward/backward loss backpropagation during self-training.
self_evolution_link: ModelExpansion scales layer dimensions and heads dynamically.
curriculum_link: Inference outputs aligned with educational curriculum standards.
safety_gates: Zero Python AI connection: 100% native compiled Rust runtime
Dynamic SHA-256 validation of SafeTensors weights on startup
Temperature clamping [0.0, 2.0] and top-p sampling boundaries prevent degenerated loops

lifecycle.1_discover: ModelRegistry locates active model weights directory
lifecycle.2_validate: Compute dynamic SHA-256 of model.safetensors and check integrity
lifecycle.3_load: Read config.json and stream tensor buffers into memory via SafeTensors reader
lifecycle.4_tokenize: TaraTokenizer encodes input string into subword token IDs
lifecycle.5_forward: Execute 22 decoder layers: RoPE + GQA attention + SwiGLU MLP + RMSNorm
lifecycle.6_sample: Apply temperature, top-k, and top-p filtering to logits to select next token
lifecycle.7_stream: Yield token text immediately to user response stream
lifecycle.8_control: Parse control tokens for automated skill/action dispatch
